termsReviewNotes: Mass.gov privacy policy reviewed. Source-specific redistribution and publication approval for occupational license fields has not been confirmed.

knownExclusions: The shared DOL portals include many professions and credential levels; contractor, business, master, journeyperson, and apprentice records must not be conflated.
Construction supervisor licensing, HIC registration, OPSI pipefitter/refrigeration/sprinkler credentials, asbestos, DCAMM certification, and local permits are separate source paths.

rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Use official DOL lookup portals manually and do not bypass portal controls.
publicRecordsNotes: Official credential-lookup metadata only. Absence from one profession or credential type is not proof that another authorization does not exist.
officialLookupReviewNotes: DOL's check-a-license page links official portals for occupational boards and OPSI credentials.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No stable official bulk download or redistribution-safe export was confirmed during this review.
researchNotes: This source captures DOL occupational board trade credentials such as electricians, plumbers/gas fitters, and sheet-metal workers while keeping OPSI and HIC paths separate.
verificationCaveats: Profession, board, credential type, and business-versus-individual status must be preserved.
No matching record means no match in the selected DOL source and credential type at the checked time.
verificationNotes: No supported adapter is exposed while the shared DOL lookup portals lack a reviewed stable machine interface.
maintainerNotes: Future adapters must retain board, license class, business/individual distinction, checked time, caveats, and privacy review.
